resourceBoundary.policy: Complete correlated retained receipt or typed refusal; the request names only a file path and no video bytes or frames cross in either direction.

semantics: Link one desktop video file as a new layer, or relink an existing drawing video placement, through the existing native transaction/history owner as one revision and one history entry. The host canonicalizes the absolute path inside the request's filesystem scope, requires a regular UTF-8 file, opens the installed native video decoder once for width, height and frame count, always closes that session, and refuses zero facts; the canonical path is the stored locator and the deduplication identity. Exact replay and refusals that need no file are answered before any file access. A replace keeps the placement id, target, offset and stored timing (including time-remap keys) and keeps the previous record; relinking the same file is invalid. Image codecs, sequences, embedded video bytes, DOM drop handles and browser/WASM routes remain unavailable.
